name: Thread Your Logo
old_description: Invigorate your branding with products that promote fitness and a healthy lifestyle.
about:
Thread Your Logo operates from Clarksville, Maryland, providing nationwide custom apparel and decoration services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in embroidery, screen printing, direct-to-film (DTF) transfers, heat transfer, and sublimation, offering custom manufacturing and company store programs. It handles uniform programs, bags, drinkware, office and technology accessories, and luxury athletic apparel from brands such as Adidas, Nike, and Under Armour. The company services clients across all 50 states.

Its customer base spans healthcare (MedStar, Kaiser Permanente, Johns Hopkins), education (Carnegie Mellon, Georgetown, Howard University), corporate (Amazon, Citibank, Oracle, State Farm, Target, UPS), non-profit (Jack & Jill, New York Restoration Project), military (Military Bowl), hospitality (Royal Sonesta), government (M-NCPPC), and fitness (Yoga Alliance).

Thread Your Logo emphasizes fast turnaround, competitive pricing, free design assistance and mockups, and a 24-hour quote process, positioning itself as a bulk-order specialist that takes pride in every garment processed through its facility.
type_evidence: Thread Your Logo is a full service embroidery and screen printing company
